title: Monkey holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M63 40 Q60 55 55 66' stroke='#f5f0c0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='28' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#ff5a6e'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='22' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ff9aa6'/>
  <path d='M64 43 L68 43 L66 47 Z' fill='#d93a50'/>
  <!-- monkey body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='70' rx='17' ry='18' fill='#9b6237'/>
  <!-- monkey belly -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='72' rx='10' ry='12' fill='#e0b183'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='86' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#7d4c28'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='86' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#7d4c28'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='64' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#9b6237' transform='rotate(-25 29 64)'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='60' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#9b6237' transform='rotate(25 63 60)'/>
  <!-- raised arm holding string -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='58' rx='5' ry='8' fill='#9b6237' transform='rotate(-30 58 58)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='46' r='15' fill='#9b6237'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='43' r='5' fill='#9b6237'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='43' r='2.5' fill='#e0b183'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='43' r='5' fill='#9b6237'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='43' r='2.5' fill='#e0b183'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='50' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#e0b183'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#3a2416'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#3a2416'/>
  <circle cx='41.8' cy='43.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='51.8' cy='43.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='49' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#7d4c28'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M41 53 Q46 57 51 53' stroke='#7d4c28' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
